content: As for the proposed models, both INLINEFORM0 and INLINEFORM1 yield comparable results to CopyRNN, indicating that One2Seq paradigm can work well as an alternative option for the keyphrase generation. INLINEFORM2 outperforms INLINEFORM3 on all metrics, suggesting the semantic coverage and orthogonal regularization help the model to generate higher quality keyphrases and achieve better generalizability. To our surprise, on the metric F INLINEFORM4 @10 for KP20k and Krapivin (average number of keyphrases is only 5), where high-recall models like CopyRNN are more favored, INLINEFORM5 is still able to outperform One2One baselines, indicating that the proposed mechanisms for diverse generation are effective.
